CustomField.description: Datetime stamped by the formTemplate LWC when the respondent clicks Email me a resume link. The Form_Submission trigger watches this field — when it transitions to a non-blank value, the trigger generates a cryptographically random Internal_Unique_Token__c. Cleared by Form_Submission_Prefill on resume-link consumption, by the trigger when Submission_Date__c is stamped, and by the scheduled Form_Submission_Expire_Resume_Tokens flow after the configured window.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Stamped with the current datetime when the respondent clicks "Email me a resume link" in the stages overview. Triggers the Form_Submission trigger to generate Internal_Unique_Token__c and the Form_Submission_Send_Resume_Link flow to send the email. Cleared on consumption, on form submission, and on scheduled expiration.
CustomField.label: Send Resume Link
